executedScope: validate_transcription: nonempty/nonblank Korean-language metadata and translate strictly false
Finite numeric nonboolean PCM duration inclusive 10–600 seconds and segment offsets
Negative/reversed/overlapping segments and offsets beyond actual PCM duration plus 30 milliseconds rejected; exact 30 millisecond boundary accepted
Temporary pinned CLI/model hash mismatch fails before decoder/ASR subprocess launch or output creation
Existing output preserved; output symlink rejected before subprocess launch
staticReviewScope: PCM duration comes from decoded mono 16-bit 16 kHz WAV frame count, with truncation check
Pinned tool/source hashes checked before work and again after transcription
Receipt is TECHNICAL_ASR_RECORDED, requiresSuccessfulExitReceipt=true; it does not attest direct listening or natural pronunciation
After receipt fsync, remaining budget is checked; receipt hashing also checks budget before stdout receipt is emitted
limitations: No actual ASR subprocess was executed by this independent test run. Prelaunch negative fixtures replace tool paths and pin hashes with temporary files and assert subprocess.run is never called.

Late fsync deadline behavior was checked by source order only, not by executing a synthetic successful transcription or injected filesystem delay. A retained RECORDED artifact without successful exit and matching stdout hash must not be consumed as a completed run.
Actual installed CLI/model hashes, audio semantic correctness, direct listening, pronunciation quality and final video synchronization are outside this fixture proof.
Path symlink rejection checks existing path components at validation time; this is a trusted local workspace tool, not a guarantee against a concurrently hostile filesystem race.
